g.text: LKE Enterprise NodePort + ExternalDNS — DNS resolution architecture
Linode VPC · dual-stack (shared by both clusters)
Client VM: the ~ route-only domain sends only .internal to Linode NS; Network Helper keeps serving everything else and never overwrites the systemd-resolved drop-in.
Cluster: workload-coredns keeps the kubernetes plugin for cluster.local and forwards only .internal to Linode NS, so pods resolve both the zone and cluster services.
